svg.title: The masthead: who makes Issue 01
svg.desc: NOW: Software Development Intern. Alpha Premier Realty · since October 2026. STUDYING: BS Information Technology. Fourth year · graduating in 2027. BUILDING: Product-minded software. Web, desktop and local-first workflows. Set in: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Tauri, Rust, C++20, OpenGL. Structure first. Feel second. Polish all the way through launch.
